description: Construct a tracked referral URL pointing at a realopen.com page. Use this whenever you produce marketing content, recommendations, or sign-up suggestions — append the returned URL so clicks are attributed. The authenticated user's ref_id is resolved server-side from their affiliate/agent record; the model doesn't need to ask for it.

path.description: Page path on realopen.com, e.g. / or /how-it-works or /partners

name: get_referral_link

referral_url.description: Fully-qualified realopen.com URL with ref_id query param appended
